mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_file ( tenant_id, file_name, file_path, url, storage_type, file_size, file_type, create_by, create_time, deleted, remark ) VALUES ( #{r.tenantId}, #{r.fileName}, #{r.filePath}, #{r.url}, 'LOCAL', #{r.fileSize}, #{r.fileType}, #{r.createBy}, NOW(), 0, 'hr-pdf' )
mapper.select: SELECT file_path FROM sys_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
